narrative: HAL has been in clean daily expansion since the 06 Aug gap (+4.8% on 4.8m shares against a ~600k norm), printing higher highs and higher lows: 4603.30 -> 4803.40 -> 4924.20 on the low side, 4975.00 -> 5055.00 -> 5149.90 on the high side. Today's session broke the 5055.00 swing high — a break of structure with the trend — and tagged 5149.90 before easing back to 5082. There is no resting sell-side pool of consequence above; the draw is buy-side, above today's high. The 14 Aug expansion left an unfilled 1H fair value gap at 4970.80-5007.00 that has not been rebalanced, and it sits exactly inside the 62-79% retracement of the 4924.20 -> 5149.90 leg. That overlap is the entry, not the 5082 print.
invalidation: A 1H close below 4950.10 puts price under the order block that produced the 14 Aug expansion; a close below 4924.20 breaks the higher-low sequence and ends the continuation thesis. Entry is a resting limit — if price never retraces to 4990.00 there is no trade. No TP2 is quoted: 5149.90 is the six-month high and there is no mapped liquidity above it, so anything beyond TP1 is trailed, not targeted.
